source_text: Sacrificium laudis cum placentis oleo. Eucharistia — gratiarum actio. Cantate Domino.
pass_a_gloss: Sacrifice of-praise with cakes oil. Eucharist — of-thanks action. Sing to-Lord.
pass_b_english: A [[sacrifice of praise with oil cakes >> Bible:Leviticus 7:12]] — thanksgiving, the church’s eucharist. Sing to the Lord.
